title: mysql Join postgres  Insert postgres
content: -- comment: mysql多表联查postgres表并全量同步至postgres数据表示例
-- author: 超级管理员
-- wiki: https://gitee.com/boy_0214/websql/wikis/pages?sort_id=17181366&doc_id=3405209
-- 数据源管理 - 新增数据源2个数据源 -> PostgreSQL数据源标识: postgresql_calcite_1 Mysql数据源标识:mysql_calcite_1
-- postgresql创建2张测试数据表: products,dim_order_info mysql测试2张表: orders,users 并创建测试数据
-- 易枢方舟-数据开发-SQL窗口 - 执行下方SQL

INSERT INTO postgresql_calcite_1.dim_order_info (
                 id,
                 order_id,
                 username,
                 email,
                 product_name,
                 category,
                 quantity,
                 price,
                 total_amount,
                 order_date,
                 status
             )
             SELECT
                 o.order_id id,
                 o.order_id,
                 u.username,
                 u.email,
                 p.product_name,
                 p.category,
                 o.quantity,
                 p.price,
                 o.total_amount,
                 o.order_date,
                 o.status
             FROM mysql_calcite_1.orders o
             JOIN mysql_calcite_1.users u ON o.user_id = u.id
             JOIN postgresql_calcite_1.products p ON o.product_id = p.product_id;
description: 多源多表联查并全量同步至postgres

title: mysql Join postgres Upsert In postgres
content: -- comment: 多源多表联查增量同步至postgres示例
-- author: 超级管理员
-- wiki: https://gitee.com/boy_0214/websql/wikis/pages?sort_id=17181366&doc_id=3405209
-- 数据源管理 - 新增数据源2个数据源 -> PostgreSQL数据源标识: postgresql_calcite_1 Mysql数据源标识:mysql_calcite_1
-- postgresql创建2张测试数据表: products,dim_order_info mysql测试2张表: orders,users 并创建测试数据

UPSERT INTO postgresql_calcite_1.dim_order_info
              SELECT
                  o.order_id,
                  o.order_id,
                  o.order_id,
                  u.username,
                  u.email,
                  p.product_name,
                  p.category,
                  o.quantity,
                  p.price,
                  o.total_amount,
                  o.order_date,
                  o.status
              FROM mysql_calcite_1.orders o
              JOIN mysql_calcite_1.users u ON o.user_id = u.id
              JOIN postgresql_calcite_1.products p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
              WHERE o.order_id > (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(order_id), 0) FROM postgresql_calcite_1.dim_order_info) -- 增量条件
description: 多源多表联查并增量同步至postgres

title: postgres Upsert In mysql
content: -- comment:  postgres查询增量同步至mysql示例
-- author: 超级管理员

upsert into mysql_calcite_2.products
             select
               product_id as id,    -- 别名需于MySQL目标表字段名对应
               product_name as name,
               price
             from
               postgresql_calcite_1.products
             where
             -- 时间增量条件,使用临时表方式获取当前时间-1
               created_at >= (
                 SELECT
                   TIMESTAMPADD(DAY, -1, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
                 from
                   postgresql_calcite_1.products
                 limit
                   1
               )
